headline: OMV CEO Says Low Fuel Stocks Will Keep Global Refining Markets Tight
summary: OMV chief executive Emma Delaney stated that low global fuel inventories will maintain tightness in worldwide refining markets, noting that the group's Abu Dhabi operations recovered quickly from supply disruptions.
why: Refinery utilization rates and inventory levels directly drive global petroleum product margins and crack spreads.

impacts.name: OMV
impacts.why: Tight refining markets and sustained product margins support downstream profitability for oil refiners.
